segments.title: how a vanished deed produces a result

spans.eng: up to the point at which

spans.tib: las las 'bras bu ji ltar 'byung bar 'gyur
spans.eng: How then does a deed or karma ever produce any kind of consequence?

segments.note: English-first alignment by Codex, PROVISIONAL machine analysis. The first las de is attached once to the explicit demonstrative that deed; GMR's earlier a karma or deed is left as supplied repetition. The final karma-result question remains whole at d3 because English changes Tibetan result-arises-from-deed into deed-produces-result; atomizing the verb would reverse causal roles. The relative clause containing the probable affect/effect typo and the supplied final we are left unlinked.
